question: Xi Jinping out before 2027?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if China's General Secretary of the Communist Party, Xi Jinping, is removed from power for any length of time between July 3, 2025, and December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

CCP General Secretary Xi Jinping will be considered removed from power if he announces his resignation from his role as General Secretary, or is otherwise dismissed, detained, disqualified, or otherwise loses his position or is prevented from fulfilling his duties as General Secretary within this market's timeframe.

The primary resolution source for this market will be a consensus of credible reporting.

eventMetadata.context_description: Xi Jinping's consolidated control over the Chinese Communist Party and absence of any designated successor or internal factional challenges underpin trader consensus that he will remain paramount leader through at least the 21st Party Congress in 2027. Recent leadership meetings and policy rollouts for the 15th Five-Year Plan period demonstrate his ongoing authority, with no reported moves toward retirement or power-sharing. While formal term norms were altered years ago, the lack of visible elite opposition or health disclosures sustains the high implied probability against an early exit. Plausible shifts could still arise from sudden illness, acute economic or security crises prompting collective pressure, or unexpected personnel changes at senior levels, though such developments remain speculative given current stability.
